description: This file defines an enumeration for the different statuses of a share account in the Fineract system, including utility methods to interpret status codes and check specific status conditions.

classes.name: ShareAccountStatusType
classes.description: An enum representing various states of a share account, such as submitted, approved, active, rejected, or closed. It provides methods to convert from integer codes and to check specific statuses.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer type code to its corresponding ShareAccountStatusType enum value.

methods.name: hasStateOf
methods.description: Checks if the current status matches a given state.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer code associated with the status.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the status.

methods.name: isSubmittedAndPendingApproval
methods.description: Checks if the status is 'submitted and pending approval'.

methods.name: isActiveOrAwaitingApprovalOrDisbursal
methods.description: Checks if the status is either approved, submitted and pending approval, or active.

methods.name: isClosed
methods.description: Checks if the status is 'closed' or 'rejected'.
